h: 我想玩一下最近发布的欧尼金模型，所以我制定了一个快速工作流程来加载 0-3 个图像（批量或手动）并将它们加载到生成器中。没什么太花哨的，但它确实有一个文本节点，其中包含有关在自动下载失败时如何获取模型的说明。

o.en: I wanted to play around with the recently releasedOmnigenmodel, so I whipped up a quick Workflow to load 0-3 images (batch or manual) and load them in to the generator. Nothing too fancy, but it does have a text node with instructions on how to get the model, if the autodownload fails.
